messages:
maya: small canary done for 'strand-coalesce-v1' on prod-helix. p50 -10ms, p95 -13ms, token-cost -8.3%. ramping to 30% over next 2h :tada:

sam: nice. dashboard?

maya: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/strand-coalesce-v1-canary (canary view)

raj: any p99 regressions on long sessions (>4k)?

maya: p99 stable overall. model-y shows +2.7% on >4k tied to cache churn during bursts. plan to tweak coalesce_window for model-y.

anne: memory or GPU pressure?

maya: mem +1-3% per GPU. GPU util smoother. tested on a100/h100.

perf-bot: deploy runtime:strand-coalesce-v1 @ 3351112222 started, rollout 10%.

kyle: config used?

maya: ```
coalescer:
  strategy: strand
  coalesce_window_ms: 8
  max_batch_size: 512
  eager_flush_threshold: 20
```

sam: add metric for strand_misprediction_rate so we can alert on degradation?

maya: added runtime.strand_mispred_rate and dashboard panel. alert if >5% above baseline.

raj: can we split by customer tier? want Dedicated separate.

maya: doing dedicated 15% / hosted 15% split now.

infra-bot: rollout updated -> 30% (dedicated split) @ 3351112330.

anne: update runbook with rollback conditions: auto-fallback if p99 > baseline*1.06 for 10m.

maya: runbook updated, flag runtime.flags.strand_coal_v1_rollout. triggered perf stress jobs perf-ci/strand-coal-longseq (ETA 40m) and perf-ci/strand-coal-burst.

kyle: triggered A/B eval on promptset-v4 for quality checks.

maya: evals/strand-coal-v1-qa kicked off (ETA ~90m). will post results in #eng-runtime. tagging @sam @raj @anne @kyle
